title: 0418137-DC/Si-D/FR-[ MP/ P8 170001008] Engie VIANEO-Cfast card corrupt-C1
description:
Reported issue:  On SCB the statuts of the connectors are always faulted and unknown. Yet on site and on OCPP backend outlets are available. There is also no logs on SCB The charger also takes more than 30 minutes to reboot. After the boot process it stays in hallo hello mode for 30min at least.
Solution:
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-04-09
Out of warranty
14.04.2025: Handover from ES to NOC

additional_info.subject: Reason for child case creation
additional_info.body:
Suspect cfast card corrupt, needed confirmation from ES prior to advising site visit.
Found:
No logs fetched on SCB & AWS
SCB landing page reflects outlets out of order whereas on site they are available and working

additional_info.subject: Handover from ES to NOC
additional_info.body:
Please instruct the region to flash the CFast card
I checked remotely via SSH the Hawkbit.conf file and the AWS certificate and everything seems correct.
From Remote Frontend, the charger seems stuck in Hello/Hallo screen
Please inform also the region and End Customer that this is a Out of warranty case. 1 hour of support provided by ES
